            prev = key
            has_prev = True
            wrapped(path + (key,), value, flattened)
        frames_checked.append((172, path, tuple(seq), type(structure).__name__))
    elif not dmtree.is_nested(structure):
        flattened.append((path, structure))
    elif isinstance(structure, collections.abc.Mapping):
        prev = None
        has_prev = False
        seq = []
        for key in sorted(structure):
            seq.append(key)
            if has_prev and key < prev:
                violations.append({
                    "loop": 177,
                    "path": path,
                    "prev": prev,
                    "key": key,
                    "sequence": tuple(seq),
                    "structure_type": type(structure).__name__,

            prev = key
            has_prev = True
            wrapped(path + (key,), structure[key], flattened)
        frames_checked.append((177, path, tuple(seq), type(structure).__name__))
    else:
        for key, value in enumerate(structure):
            wrapped(path + (key,), value, flattened)
